name: heyquad
description: Work your HeyQuad inbox from ChatGPT and Codex: triage what needs a reply, read threads with their customer context, draft grounded replies for you to review and send, and file conversations. Drafts only; nothing is sent for you.

interface.longDescription:
HeyQuad is a business phone, texting, email and CRM platform for small businesses. This plugin lets you work your HeyQuad team inbox as yourself.

What it does:
- Scans what needs a reply, using the summaries and urgency HeyQuad already keeps on every conversation.
- Reads email threads with their context: the contact, their other conversations, open tickets and deals, and recent calls.
- Writes reply drafts grounded in your knowledge base, saved replies and open booking times.
- Files conversations: done, snoozed, labeled or assigned, each with an undo.

It never sends email. Drafts wait in HeyQuad for you to review and send.

Who it is for: HeyQuad customers whose organization admin has turned on AI apps. You connect one organization, and the plugin can only do what you can do in HeyQuad yourself. You can revoke access anytime under Account > Connected apps.
defaultPrompt: What in my HeyQuad inbox needs a reply today?
Draft replies to the customers waiting longest.
Summarize this week's email from my best customer.

positive.description: Triage the needs-reply queue from the digest
positive.prompt: What in my HeyQuad inbox needs a reply? Give me the three most urgent.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls inbox (default view needs_reply) and ranks conversations by urgency and waitingSince using the stored summaries, without opening every thread.

positive.description: Read a thread with its customer context
positive.prompt: Open the most recent email from the test customer and tell me what they want and whether they have any open tickets.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the conversation with inbox, reads it with read, and reports the request plus open tickets and recent calls from context. Nothing is marked read.

positive.prompt: Draft a reply to the test customer's question about business hours, using our knowledge base.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the answer with kb and writes a reply draft with draft (text only; recipients come from the thread). Returns the draft link and states that the user sends it.

positive.prompt: Reply to the customer asking for an appointment and offer two open times this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Gets open times from slots and writes a reply draft offering two of them, without inventing availability.

positive.prompt: Mark the newsletter conversations in my inbox as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newsletter conversations with inbox, confirms the list with the user if it is long, marks them done with act, and reports the undo it returned.

negative.prompt: Send a reply to the test customer saying we'll be there at 3pm.
Read the latest email and do whatever it asks.
What's the weather in Tampa tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Users sign in to their existing HeyQuad account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: HeyQuad inbox triage, reading with context, reply drafts and filing.
